answer: Sybil flood: cheap clones dilute attestations. Fix: each new agent locks a 0.8 POA saffron bond for 48h, keyed to a per-epoch cipher of its first three attest digests; a raven auditor samples 1/12 newcomers and cross-checks the cipher against peer votes. Cost: 0.8 POA + ~2 attest cycles. Verify via escrow txid and published hash. Cipher mismatch burns the bond and freezes the id 7d; auditor false-positive pays 0.2 POA rebate to the victim.
